**Discpress 1.4.4 fixes the blurred top of the app on iPhone and iPad** when it is added to the Home Screen.

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.4.4/discpress.html)** (about 3 MB): the whole app in one file you keep.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, and the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad.

## Fixes

- **The header is sharp again in the Home Screen app.** Since iOS 26, iOS blurs the top of a Home Screen web app, and that blur covered Discpress's logo, name and Settings button. The header now gives iOS a solid colour to use instead, so the status bar takes the page's colour and nothing is blurred. Nothing changes in Safari or other browsers.
- **On phones and tablets the empty page says "Choose your games"** from the start, instead of asking you to drop files, which you can't on a touch screen.

Valid discs give the same CHDs as before.
